svg.text: LINE-CARD SEATING FIXTURE: CUSTOM PARTS (all dimensions mm; sheet is 1:1 at A3 landscape, print at 100 %)

Coordinates: x = depth behind the steel strip's front face (chassis-front reference plane; negative = in front, toward the robot); y = distance in from that card end (left end shown; right-end parts are mirror images); z = height above the bench.

Proud = gap from the strip front face to the faceplate block's back face. Lever angle theta: 0 = closed flat on the faceplate, 45 = open (start). Parametric source of every part: fixture.scad (same numbers). Tolerances unless noted: +-0.1 on cam edges and bores, +-0.3 elsewhere.
A CATCH PLATE, left (2 req: left + mirrored right) - drawn 2:1 - 5 mm mild steel, laser/waterjet
DATUM A: strip front face (x = 0); plate rear edge butts it
DATUM B: card end (y = 0) = guide inner face + 0.5 mm
Inside corners V3 V4 V5 R<=1.5.
steel angle bolted to the strip;
rear edge pressed on datum A;
slide in y until V6 is 9.8 in
B HUB ARM (2 req, mirrored) - 1:1 - 8 mm steel flat
Pivot bore dia 6 H7 (on the pin; M4 set
screw onto a pin flat + dia 2 spring pin).
Dowel bore dia 6 H7: ISO 8734 6 m6 x 20
dowel pressed flush at top, 12 below.
Shown with the lever CLOSED: the arm
back (130 deg from the lever axis).
Arm z 91-99; bottom ear bushing is its
thrust face. Lever 45 deg open: dowel
is at 40 deg: a push on the card turns

Bore dia 10 H7: bronze flanged bushing 6x10x6,
into block top/bottom); bore on y 12.0 in.
Top ear z 149-152, bottom ear z 102-105.

Bore dia 6 H7 vertical through the 30,
10 from pivot end, centred on the 20.
Pivot end full R10 (clears the faceplate).
M4 axial tapped hole from pivot end
(set screw on the pin flat) and
Strike: dia 16x2 steel disc, M3 csk,
in a 2 deep back-face pocket at 85.
Grip grooves 88-98 on the front face.
E STACK AT THE LEFT LEVER PIVOT (side elevation, 1:1, x to the left = toward the robot)
Datum z 105 = slot floor (guide top face); bench z 0.
Clearances: hub arm 2.0 above plate, 3.0 below ear.

Fixture: proud vs lever angle while closing (computed)
Plunger: M16x1.5 spring plunger, steel thrust pin,
stroke >= 8, end force 50 N preloaded, <= 62 N
at 8 (rate <= 1.5 N/mm). One per card end, axis
y 40 in from the card end, z 119, through a
slots) on the rear cross member at x 440.
Nose set to x 413.1: card held at 6.00 proud by
